title: Coordination of Repair Works to Minimise Excavation of Roads
what_it_is: Coordination of Repair Works to Minimise Excavation of Roads

sections.label: Road works coordination committee
sections.summary: The Road Opening Coordination Committee coordinates road works by government agencies and service providers, though emergency repairs cannot be planned.

sentences.speaker: Mr Khaw Boon Wan
sentences.text: Road works are coordinated by the Road Opening Coordination Committee (ROCC) which comprises representatives from Government agencies, utility and telecoms service providers.

sentences.speaker: Mr Khaw Boon Wan
sentences.text: As far as possible, the Committee schedules the work plans of the respective agencies to minimise inconvenience to commuters and residents.

sentences.speaker: Mr Khaw Boon Wan
sentences.text: However, some works cannot be planned for, such as emergency repairs of cable faults or gas leaks.

sentences.speaker: Mr Khaw Boon Wan
sentences.text: We will ask the Committee to consider publishing indicators of the effectiveness of their coordination efforts.
